title: Send Amount Limits and Wallet Provider Caps — Mobile Wallet
content:
**Mobile Wallet** principal limits are set per tier, and every wallet provider has its own cap on a single credit. All amounts are principal in USD.

### Principal range and per-recipient frequency by tier

| Tier | Smallest principal per transfer | Largest principal per transfer | Most Mobile Wallet transfers to one recipient in a rolling 24 hours |
|---|---|---|---|
| Mobile Wallet Micro | 5.00 | 100.00 | 5 |
| Mobile Wallet Economy | 10.00 | 2999.00 | 3 |
| Mobile Wallet Express | 10.00 | 2999.00 | 5 |
| Mobile Wallet Express Plus | 50.00 | 5000.00 | 5 |
| Mobile Wallet Priority | 10.00 | 2999.00 | 5 |
| Mobile Wallet Large Amount | 1500.00 | 5000.00 | 1 |

The largest principal per transfer is the tier's own figure, before the per-transfer limit of the customer's Personal Sender Account level.

### Provider caps (every tier)

The provider cap is the largest principal a single credit to that provider may carry, reflecting the provider's own receiving limits. The caps are the same on all six Mobile Wallet tiers.

| Wallet provider | Cap per credit (USD) |
|---|---|
| GCash | 1700.00 |
| Maya | 1700.00 |
| M-Pesa | 1930.00 |
| MTN MoMo | 1200.00 |
| bKash | 2450.00 |
| Nequi | 1600.00 |
| Tigo Money | 650.00 |

### Boundary illustrations (hypothetical amounts)

- A principal of exactly 650.00 to a Tigo Money wallet is within that provider's cap; 650.01 is above it.
- On Mobile Wallet Micro a principal of 5.00 or of 100.00 lies inside the tier's range; 4.99 and 100.01 lie outside it.
- On Mobile Wallet Large Amount the smallest principal is 1500.00, so 1499.99 is below that tier's range.
